name: walk_cane
text: A person walks forward with a cane in the right hand. The right leg is healthy and the left leg needs support. The cane and left foot advance together, then stay planted while the right leg steps through. Repeat this slow steady walking rhythm, keep holding the cane, no turning or stopping.

trim.reason: Middle complete cane/left-foot gait cycle; swing clearance refined before generation. No joint editing or time scaling.

notes: Right-hand rigid 0.82 m cane supports left leg; per-frame tilt in support.json.
Natural tilt fitted around a fixed stance anchor; output NPZ only trimmed, no pose edits.
Swing clearance added in conditioning; mapped toe minimum -0.00806 m.
Source fingers are relaxed, not a modeled tight wrap around the grip.
